operations.description: Pool 96 TaqMan assays at final 0.2× each. Reaction total 10 µL: 5 µL 2× PreAmp master mix, 2.5 µL pooled assay mix (0.2×), 2.5 µL cDNA containing 125 ng. One cycle 95 °C/10 min, then 14 cycles 95 °C/15 s and 60 °C/4 min. Dilute product 1:5 with TE, store −20 °C.

operations.description: Per sample premix: 3.5 µL 2× Fast Universal master mix +0.35 µL 20× GE loading reagent. Source then aliquots 3.5 µL of this premix and adds 3.15 µL preamplified cDNA; preserve those distinct volumes without correcting arithmetic. Vortex, centrifuge and keep on ice. Separate assay plate: 3 µL 20× single assay +3 µL 2× assay loading reagent.

operations.description: Prime 96.96 dynamic arrays with preset IFC Controller HX protocol; load 5 µL sample and 5 µL TaqMan assay per respective inlet; process with IFC Controller HX; BioMark HD software v3.0.2. Source describes ΔCt using media-only negative control, ΔΔCt using β-actin normalizer, and 18S rRNA endogenous control. Algorithm wording retained as printed.
